title: Kestrel Transfer Distance and Shipping Fee Terms by Vehicle Program
content:
A vehicle bought under Vehicle Purchase Agreements travels from the hub that holds it to the buyer's market. Four shipping terms differ by vehicle program.

| Vehicle program | Free transfer distance (miles) | Shipping fee discount | Charged shipping fee refunded on customer cancellation after transfer or on return | Shipping fee on an exchange replacement vehicle waived |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | 0 | 0 percent | No | No |
| Kestrel Inspected | 0 | 0 percent | No | No |
| Kestrel Certified | 100 | 0 percent | No | No |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | 100 | 25 percent | No | Yes |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | 250 | 50 percent | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | 250 | 50 percent | Yes | Yes |

**Meaning of each term.**
- Free transfer distance: the transfer distance up to which no shipping fee is charged. A free transfer distance of 0 miles means every transfer of one mile or more is above it.
- Shipping fee discount: the percentage taken off the shipping fee for that program.
- Refund of a charged shipping fee: whether a shipping fee already charged is refunded when the customer cancels the order after the vehicle has been transferred, or when the vehicle is returned.
- Exchange shipping waiver: whether the shipping fee on the replacement vehicle of an exchange is waived.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- A Kestrel Certified vehicle with a transfer distance of 100 miles is within the free transfer distance; at 101 miles it is above it.
- A Kestrel Premium Certified vehicle with a transfer distance of 240 miles is within that program's 250-mile free transfer distance.
